results.title: Private legal practitioner and anti-corruption campaigner Lawyer Martin Kpebu has directly brought businessman Alfred Mahama into the center
results.description:
Private legal practitioner and anti-corruption campaigner Lawyer Martin Kpebu has directly brought businessman Alfred Mahama into the center of the unfolding extractive sector scandal, citing his alleged involvement in the disputed revocation of licenses and armed takeovers of concessions belonging to indigenous mining firms Narawa Company Limited and Northern Ashanti Mines Limited.

Speaking live during the Saturday, October 31, 2026 edition of TV3’s frontline political affairs programme, The KeyPoints, Kpebu scrutinized the regulatory decisions of the Minerals Commission, asserting that state security apparatus and administrative revocations are being weaponized to dispossess Ghanaian investors and transfer viable concessions to foreign Chinese syndicates.
